root_causes.description: Cart service pods experiencing excessive restarts (z=>1000) with extreme cpu spike (z=+12.54) and memory spike (z=+21.72), indicating OOM kill or process failure. Frontend errors propagate from downstream cart dependency failure.
Frontend error_rate z=>1000 observed, but analysis shows this is a symptom of downstream cart pod_crash rather than primary cause. Frontend propagates errors from cart dependency failure.

evidence.observed_value: no error traces found in frontend during window
evidence.expected_baseline: error traces present under normal operation

root_causes.description: Checkout p99_latency_ms z=+1.99 observed (61.77ms window vs 38.69ms baseline), indicating increased latency. However, checkout shows no corresponding cpu/memory/restart anomalies, suggesting this is a secondary effect rather than root cause.

remediation_steps: Restart cart pods and investigate OOM conditions - check container logs for memory allocation failures
Implement cart pod resource limits and requests to prevent future OOM kills; add monitoring alerts on cart memory/cpu thresholds
